logic.note: I2C at 0x76/0x77: chip id 0x60, soft reset, calibration block (0x88-0xA1, 0xE1-0xE7), ctrl_hum/ctrl_meas/config, sleep/forced/normal mode, skipped measurements (0x80000 / 0x8000 when oversampling is 0) and burst reads of 0xF7-0xFE. Raw values come from inverting the datasheet's integer compensation, so Adafruit_BME280 reads the prop values back to 0.01 °C, about 0.01 hPa and 0.001 %RH.

timing.note: Conversions finish instantly: the status register never shows 'measuring', and normal mode has a fresh sample at every read whatever the standby time.

analog.note: No sensor noise, IIR filter or self-heating; one fixed calibration set instead of a per-chip one. Values are exactly what you set.

power.note: Fixed 0.4 mA from VIN; answers only from 3.0 V. 10 kOhm pull-ups on SDA and SCL.
